Card Q&A.a: Yes, even if you only reveal one of the applicable cards, you can still add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include only either a card with [Pulsemon] in its text or a card with the [Abadin Electronics] trait, can I only add 1 card to my hand?

Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's [On Play] effect include both a card with [Pulsemon] in its text and a card with the [Abadin Electronics] trait, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with [Pulsemon] in its text and 1 card with the [Abadin Electronics] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon has [Pulsemon] in its text, it gets +1000 DP.
